author: John Keith

sources.role: author instructions and UserRPL source listing, copied into downloaded archive as baseconvert.html

execution_kind: UserRPL calculator programs, not ARM-native code
transport: Stock UART0 Kermit SERVER send/get/finish on original48gII; files stored under BCONV and LCONV aliases

classic48_container_observation.observed: Original48gII stores the HPHP48-W binary container as a string. Recalling it displays the binary envelope rather than executing the program. No core compatibility stop. The .49 variants from the same unmodified author archive execute successfully.
classic48_container_observation.claim: This is an observed container compatibility distinction, not a successful execution of the .48 program variants.

performance_scope: The28.4m tick preparation/execution budget includes physical key entry and settling; no isolated execution-throughput claim is made.
